# TruDrive Driveways & Patios

> Driveway and patio installers based in Wigan, covering Wigan and North West England: Greater Manchester, Merseyside, Lancashire, Cheshire and Cumbria. Run by Gaz, with over 15 years' experience. Free, no-obligation quotes: send photos on WhatsApp or ring.

- Name: TruDrive Driveways & Patios (also written TruDrive or Tru Drive). Not connected to trudrive.com, which is a different business.
- Phone and WhatsApp: 07923 485811
- Driveways: block paving, imprinted concrete, tarmac, gravel
- Patios: porcelain, Indian sandstone, crazy paving
- Also: paths and steps, fencing, brickwork, turfing and artificial grass
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@tru.drive
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Trudrive-61577305847345/
